information from multiple paragraphs. All paragraphs and the question are
shown in the user message.

message is prefixed with the agent ID who wrote it (e.g. "[A1] ..."). You
can read what previous agents have done.

These were the first international flights flown from Hobby since 1969. Houston's aviation history is showcased in the 1940 Air Terminal Museum located in the old terminal building on the west side of the airport. Hobby Airport has been recognized with two awards for being one of the top five performing airports in the world and for customer service by Airports Council International.
